create_text_labels: create formatted text labels from class IDs, scores, and class names for visualization
build_video_visualizer: build a VideoVisualizer instance with class names, top-k predictions, and a threshold mode
draw_one_frame: draw predicted class labels and bounding boxes on a single video frame image
draw_clip: draw predictions on a video clip with fade-in and fade-out alpha effects around a keyframe
draw_clip_range: draw predictions on a specified range of frames within a video clip with slow-motion repeat
